name: Nicene Creed
coreDoctrines: one God, Father Almighty, maker of heaven and earth
Jesus Christ as true God from true God
the incarnation, crucifixion, resurrection, and ascension of Christ
the Holy Spirit as Lord and giver of life
one holy catholic and apostolic Church
one baptism and the hope of resurrection
guardsAgainst: denying the full divinity of Christ
dividing the Trinity into unequal beings
reducing salvation to moral example alone
discernmentQuestions: Does this claim confess the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit faithfully?
Does it preserve the full divinity and full saving work of Christ?
Does it keep Christian hope grounded in resurrection and new creation?
